## Body

#277 corrected three connected observability traps.

A client wait deadline is not daemon acceptance: a never-submitted claim falsely cleared the old banner. Recovery requires an authenticated returned claim. The daemon now returns an empty native page at 55 seconds, before the client's 65-second timeout. Empty is health evidence, not delivery or ACK; ordinary wait clients stay unchanged.

For restart replay, select the newest sequence for exact native.receiver.lapsed/native.receiver.renewed kinds, scoped by registry seat; ignore payload-nominated IDs. OnceCell restores under native_lock before heartbeat/reconciliation. latest_matching performs two indexed LIMIT 1 reads per eligible seat, not a history scan or one fleet-wide query. Audit markers never authorize receiver liveness.

A capped refusal map must define overflow semantics: suppress-at-512 hid another seat's unseen refusal. Evict-oldest/admit-new removes that gap; refusals_evicted exposes a count only. Equally oldest timestamps still have nondeterministic HashMap tie selection: a nonblocking C34 follow-up, not a proven deterministic ordering guarantee.

Evidence: final reviewed head 5e700abc3e61c0ff273cc7531c5b6c77bc193a3c, security verdict 99e3e74. Exact-head CI restart, idle-answer and eviction regressions passed.
